##### Project general facts

Element by Iman is a residential tower by Iman Developers built around the idea of art expressed through curves. Flowing lines, sculpted edges and elegantly layered terraces shape the façade, while rounded corners and sweeping balconies with glass balustrades give the building a soft, sculptural silhouette. The collection includes studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments, layouts with a study, and three-bedroom duplexes with private pools, welcomed by a double-height entrance lobby and complemented by street-level retail units with their own outdoor terraces.

Amenities unfold across the podium and the rooftop. The podium level centres on a leisure overflow pool with an infinity edge, joined by a kids' pool, a splash pool and a jacuzzi, while selected residences open directly onto the pool deck; a walking trail, a shaded outdoor play area and seating spaces complete the level. On the rooftop, a second infinity pool with family cabanas and sun loungers sits beside a clubhouse with a coffee bar and co-working space, a fitness centre, steam and sauna, an indoor kids' play area, a yoga and meditation deck, a zen garden, an outdoor gym and a BBQ and dining area.

Inside, warm tones and tactile finishes carry the curved architecture into every residence. Generous proportions and natural light shape the living areas, which flow into kitchens with integrated cabinetry and dining space. Bedrooms are finished in soft, calm tones, and bathrooms carry elegant fittings and serene details, creating interiors that feel balanced, comfortable and refined for everyday living.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Science Park is a dedicated business and residential community set along Umm Suqeim Street, between Al Barsha South, Arjan and Dubai Miracle Garden. The district combines office campuses, research facilities and residential towers in a well-planned urban setting, with Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road running close by.

The area enjoys direct links to the city's main road corridors, giving quick access to Mall of the Emirates, Hessa Street, Dubai Marina and Ibn Battuta Mall. Global Village, Dubai Autodrome and Dubai Miracle Garden offer leisure options nearby, while Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa and both Dubai International and Al Maktoum International airports remain within comfortable driving distance. Schools, clinics and everyday retail are spread across the surrounding communities.

Positioned as a hub for companies in the science, health and energy sectors, Dubai Science Park draws a steady pool of professionals who prefer to live close to work. This built-in demand, together with central connectivity and access to established neighbouring communities, supports the district's appeal for both end users and investors seeking rental-focused residential property.
